children: DIFFRNT will build, host, secure, and manage Tersis's expanding digital presence

Miami, Florida--(Newsfile Corp. - September 3, 2026) - Tersis Technologies, Inc. (OTCID: TERS), a clean technology company advancing waste-to-value and circular infrastructure solutions, today announced that it has engaged DIFFRNT Developments to lead the development, hosting, and ongoing management of the Company's web platforms and digital infrastructure.

The engagement brings Tersis's website development, hosting, maintenance, cybersecurity, technical search optimization, CRM integrations, and related digital systems under one coordinated team. DIFFRNT will support a digital presence designed to grow alongside Tersis as the Company advances its technologies, commercial relationships, deployment opportunities, and stakeholder communications.

"Our website and digital systems need to reflect the seriousness of the work we are doing and the scale of the markets we are preparing to serve," said Antonio Uccello, Chief Executive Officer of Tersis Technologies. "DIFFRNT understands that this is not simply a design project. It is about building reliable digital infrastructure that can support our business, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and evolve as Tersis grows."

DIFFRNT Developments is a U.S.-based web development and digital infrastructure company with more than five years of experience and a U.S.-based team of more than 15 professionals. The company develops high-performance corporate, service, e-commerce, and complex digital platforms for businesses and organizations operating in the United States and international markets.

"Tersis is building an ambitious company in a sector where credibility, clarity, security, and performance matter," said Chris Pelletier of DIFFRNT Developments. "We are pleased to support Tersis with a digital platform and ongoing infrastructure program built to represent the caliber of its business and support its continued growth."

DIFFRNT's work for Tersis will include custom development, user-interface and user-experience design, technical SEO, cybersecurity, integrations, automation, hosting, ongoing maintenance, and infrastructure management. The relationship gives Tersis a single accountable partner for the continued operation and development of its web environment.

Tersis Technologies, Inc. (OTCID: TERS) is a clean technology company focused on transforming waste streams into valuable resources through advanced thermochemical conversion, carbon utilization, renewable energy, materials recovery, and sustainable infrastructure solutions. Working with municipalities, industrial partners, and governments, Tersis advances scalable technologies, including SynGenic V3™ and PolyCycle™, designed to convert suitable waste streams into energy, recovered materials, carbon products, hydrogen, and other valuable outputs, depending on feedstock, system configuration, permitting, and final engineering.

DIFFRNT Developments is a U.S.-based web development and digital infrastructure company that builds sophisticated digital platforms and websites for ambitious businesses, established brands, and organizations across the United States and international markets.

With more than five years of experience and a U.S.-based team of more than 15 professionals, DIFFRNT specializes in web development supported by custom development, UI/UX, technical SEO, cybersecurity, CRM integrations, automation, hosting, and ongoing infrastructure management. Its experience spans the automotive, e-commerce, technology, defense, government-related, compliance-driven, and professional-services sectors.
